_comment: ARC-1 rev A-rotary :: rear deck grown to take a bare 13B core (380x400x450 mm). Everything else identical to rev A so the delta is attributable.

process.name: Nodal Arc Lattice Deposition (NALD)
process.joining: WAAM-deposited node ball + drawn-arc / capacitor-discharge rod insertion
process._node_ball_note: 2.9x rod dia. Must swallow the rod ends of every incident strut and leave a fillet. Sized DOWN from 9.0: at 5,619 nodes a 9 mm ball was 17.2 kg, a third of the whole structure. Node mass is the single biggest lever in this process.
process._slenderness_note: KL/r <= 80 keeps struts at the inelastic/Euler transition. With K=0.8 and r=d/4 this gives L/d = 25 exactly.
process._K_note: Welded node ball is neither pinned (1.0) nor fixed (0.5). 0.8 is the conservative frame value.
process._len_min_note: 7.5x rod dia. Below this two node balls merge and the joint is a blob, not a truss.
process._access_note: Minimum included angle between any two struts at a node. Below this the torch/gripper cannot reach the second rod without fouling the first.
process._efficiency_note: Fraction of parent-rod capacity developed by the joint. Bare = single arc insertion. Collared = plus a wrapped WAAM fillet pass.

robot._cube_note: Reach is 1200 mm but torch attitude freedom collapses near full extension. 650 mm cube per station keeps +/-40 deg of tool tilt everywhere.

envelope._comment: Chassis outer surface as lofted stations. x = 0 at nose tip, +x rearward, +z up, y lateral (half-width given). superellipse exponent n shapes the section: 2 = ellipse, 4 = rounded rectangle.

cockpit._comment: Open trough cut downward through the tub between the two hoops.
cockpit._floor_note: Cut stops here so a 60 mm lattice floor plus seat pan survives beneath the driver.

lattice._thickness_note: Sandwich core depth. Equal to strut length so web diagonals sit near 45-55 deg - the efficient shear angle.

hard_points._comment: Suspension pickups and hoop feet. Lattice is locally densified to grade A within cluster_radius and the load is spread over every node inside it.
hard_points._placement_note: y sits just inside the lofted envelope at that x so pickup links stay short. A station ring is forced at every pickup x.
hard_points._link_note: 4 links, one per fore/aft x up/down quadrant around the pickup, so any load direction resolves axially instead of into link bending.

load_cases._comment: Applied at hard points unless stated. g = 9.81. Sprung mass 230 kg + 80 kg driver.

torsion.note: equal and opposite vertical couple across the front track, rear restrained. Reported as Nm/deg.

brake_1p5g.note: longitudinal 1.5g rearward reaction at the front pickups

cornering_2g.note: lateral 2g, load transferred to the outboard pickups

modules._comment: Build segmentation. Each module must fit the robot usable build cube.
modules.joint: flanged node-ring, 8 x M8 through-bolt into deposited boss

output._demo_note: Which module gets built as real Fusion B-rep solids. The rest stay wireframe - a full B-rep of ~20k struts will not survive Fusion.

_open_bays_note: No bulkhead cross-bracing here - the 13B core has to pass through.
